purpose: Define MorroWise delivery adapters without letting delivery mutate task state, close workflow gates, or store secrets.

allowed: send via an explicitly configured adapter after approval when the action leaves the machine
report degraded or skipped delivery state
forbidden: send external notifications without explicit approval or an approved scheduled task

env_contract.name: NOTION_DELIVERY_TOKEN
env_contract.required_when: Notion delivery is explicitly implemented and enabled

env_contract.name: NOTION_DELIVERY_TARGET
env_contract.required_when: Notion delivery is explicitly implemented and enabled

env_contract.name: CODEX_THREAD_DELIVERY_MODE
env_contract.required_when: Codex thread delivery is used as a manual handoff mode

graceful_skip.meaning: Exit 2 applies when nothing was delivered and the upstream may continue (fallback disabled or unavailable). With the macOS fallback enabled (default), missing Telegram env falls through to macos_notification_fallback instead of a silent skip.

delivery_log.rule: Every notify.sh invocation appends one JSONL line with status, detail, caller, and message length; message bodies and secrets are never logged.

forbidden: read git diff content for notification

runtime_switches: NOTIFY_MACOS_FALLBACK (default 1; 0 disables fallback for contract tests)
adapters.rule: Fires only when Telegram is not ready or its send fails; local-machine delivery only, does not reach Vincent across devices. TCC may block osascript in launchd context — a failed osascript is recorded as both_failed, never faked as delivered.
allowed_payloads: plain text notification summary, normalized to a single line and truncated to 200 bytes

adapters.recipient: LINE userId, groupId, or roomId that has permission to receive messages from the official account
allowed_payloads: text message object for approved MorroWise delivery

adapters.rule: Notion delivery is allowed only through an explicit future adapter task and approval policy; current contract records boundary only.
Thread delivery is a manual handoff/logging mode unless a future approved thread automation adapter exists.

checks: notify.sh with fallback disabled (NOTIFY_MACOS_FALLBACK=0) and missing env exits 2 in a temp fixture
notify.sh with a stub osascript and missing env delivers macos_fallback (exit 0) and appends a notify-delivery.jsonl line
notify.sh with a failing stub osascript and missing env records both_failed and exits 2
.env.example documents required adapter env names without values
LINE adapter uses Messaging API push endpoint and forbids LINE Notify
delivery adapters do not claim task-state authority
optional adapters are not marked live when unimplemented
